name: SCGM
recent: SCGM Bhd 正在推进其规范化计划，计划发行 5.697 亿股对价股份，上市日期为 2026 年 11 月 23 日。公司已获准从现金公司状态提升并重新分类行业。最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为零，净亏损 38.8 万令吉。
notable: 公司获准从现金公司状态提升并重新分类行业。
公司计划发行 5.697 亿股对价股份，作为规范化计划的一部分，上市日期为 2026 年 11 月 23 日。
公司目标在 11 月底前完成规范化计划。
risks: 公司获准延长至 2026 年 12 月 31 日完成收购，否则可能面临交易暂停或除牌。
公司处于规范化计划执行阶段，需持续满足监管要求。
earnings: 最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为零，净亏损 38.8 万令吉。

recent_en: SCGM Bhd is progressing with its regularisation plan, involving the issuance of 569.7 million consideration shares with a listing date of 23 November 2026. The company has been uplifted from cash company status and reclassified into a new sector. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was nil and net loss was RM388,000.
notable_en: The company was uplifted from cash company status and reclassified into a new sector.
The company plans to issue 569.7 million consideration shares under its regularisation plan, with listing date on 23 November 2026.
The company targets to complete its regularisation plan by end-November.
risks_en: The company has been granted an extension until 31 December 2026 to complete the acquisition, failing which trading suspension or delisting may follow.
The company is in the execution phase of its regularisation plan and must continue to meet regulatory requirements.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was nil and net loss was RM388,000.
